description: Runs Playwright tests with JSON reporter and returns structured results with pass/fail status, duration, and error messages.

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to Playwright test runner. Each element is validated to prevent flag injection.

config.description: Path to non-default Playwright config file (--config)

filter.description: Test filter pattern (file path or test name grep pattern)

forbidOnly.description: Fail if test.only is found — CI safety check (maps to --forbid-only)

grep.description: Regex pattern for matching tests by title (--grep)

headed.description: Run tests in headed browser mode

lastFailed.description: Re-run only previously failed tests (maps to --last-failed)

maxFailures.description: Stop after this many test failures (maps to --max-failures)

onlyChanged.description: Run only tests affected by recent changes (maps to --only-changed)

passWithNoTests.description: Exit successfully when no tests are found (maps to --pass-with-no-tests)

retries.description: Number of retries for failed tests (maps to --retries)

shard.description: Shard spec for distributed E2E test execution (e.g., "1/3") via --shard

workers.description: Number of parallel workers for test execution (maps to --workers)

name: playwright
title: Playwright Tests
